tasks.gr11-xho-listening-t1: Topic: Prepared speeches, critical discussions, listening comprehension, and oral response to literature. Cover speech structure (introduction, body, conclusion), preparation techniques, critical discussion turn-taking, listening for main ideas and detail, and responding analytically to literature with evidence. Ask Grade 11 FAL learners to identify speech structure elements, choose effective listening strategies, demonstrate discussion etiquette, and show how to cite textual evidence in oral responses.
tasks.gr11-xho-reading-t1: Topic: Novel, drama, poetry, media texts, theme, character, and tone. Cover character analysis using evidence, theme identification across text types, tone and mood in poetry, author's purpose in media texts, and visual literacy elements. Ask Grade 11 FAL learners to identify themes with evidence, analyse tone markers, distinguish character motivation, and interpret media design choices.
tasks.gr11-xho-writing-t1: Topic: Reflective essay, descriptive essay, friendly and formal texts, planning and drafting. Cover reflective essay structure and personal voice, descriptive language and sensory detail, register differences between friendly and formal texts, and the full writing process from brainstorm to final draft. Ask Grade 11 FAL learners to choose appropriate register, develop ideas with detail, plan essays effectively, and identify structural and language features.
tasks.gr11-xho-language-t1: Topic: Editing, style, concord (isivumelwano), punctuation, vocabulary in context, and sentence control. Cover isiXhosa noun class concord rules, punctuation marks and their functions, inferring vocabulary meaning from context, and editing for clarity and correctness. Ask Grade 11 FAL learners to apply concord rules, correct punctuation errors, infer word meaning, and identify style improvements in sentences.
